invariants.rationale: Context is required to perform rollback actions and is typically non-null in this method.
A rollback operation should refer to a valid instant, so the instant time string should not be null.
A specific HoodieInstant is needed to direct rollback, so it should not be null at method entry.
Instant strings are usually non-empty to reference a valid commit or rollback point.
The state (completed or not) of commitInstant is relevant, and the variable must exist with some completion state if not null.
